card.name: Digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit token placed inside or at the end of a multi-digit number, often a dose or table value such as 20, 50 or 100, before a unit like mg or mL.

modes.label: Dose numbers
modes.description: A digit in the middle or end of a dose amount just before mg, mL or tablets.

modes.label: Table values
modes.description: A digit inside a number in a data table or part number.

card.plain: It fires on a digit within a multi-digit number, mostly in dose amounts and tables.
